articles.title: Russia, Ukraine swap 205 prisoners of war each
articles.summary: Russia and Ukraine successfully exchanged 205 prisoners of war each on Friday, marking a significant humanitarian development amidst their ongoing conflict. This large-scale swap occurred a week after US President Donald Trump had announced such a deal. These exchanges are vital for de-escalation and improving international relations between the warring nations.

articles.title: Extension of the exclusivity period granted by the Altice France group to Bouygues Telecom, the Free–iliad Group and Orange
